python_framework_type.description: The framework this service will use. e.g. Flask, Django, FastApi, etc.

kubernetes_namespace.description: The namespace to find traefik config and pods. Relevant to health so that it can modify config in realtime.

kubernetes_deploy_namespace.description: The namespace for kubernetes to create workers and pods in. Only relevant to spawner and health.

cors_allow_origins.description: List of allowed origins for CORS.

pvc_storage_class_name.description: Which kubernetes storage class to use when creating default persistent volume claims.

pvc_default_storage_size.description: Storage size requested when creating a pod's default PersistentVolumeClaim (Kubernetes quantity string, e.g. '70Gi').

default_pod_cpu_limit.description: Default CPU allocation pod is allowed to use. In millicpus (m). 1000 = 1 cpu.

default_pod_cpu_request.description: Default CPU allocation pod requests at startup. In millicpus (m). 1000 = 1 cpu.

maximum_pod_cpu_val.description: Maximum CPU allocation pod is allowed to have as limit or request. In millicpus (m). 1000 = 1 cpu.

minimum_pod_cpu_val.description: Minimum CPU allocation pod is allowed to have as limit or request. In millicpus (m). 1000 = 1 cpu.

default_pod_mem_limit.description: Default memory allocation pod is allowed to use. In mebibytes (Mi).

default_pod_mem_request.description: Default memory allocation pod requests at startup. In mebibytes (Mi)

maximum_pod_mem_val.description: Maximum memory allocation pod is allowed to have as limit or request. In mebibytes (Mi)

minimum_pod_mem_val.description: Minimum memory allocation pod is allowed to have as limit or request. In mebibytes (Mi)

default_pod_ephemeral_storage_limit.description: Default ephemeral storage limit for pods. In mebibytes (Mi). -1 means unlimited (Kubernetes default).

default_pod_ephemeral_storage_request.description: Default ephemeral storage request for pods. In mebibytes (Mi). -1 means no guaranteed minimum (Kubernetes default).

minimum_pod_ephemeral_storage_val.description: Minimum ephemeral storage allocation pod is allowed to have as limit or request. In mebibytes (Mi)

maximum_pod_ephemeral_storage_val.description: Maximum ephemeral storage allocation pod is allowed to have as limit or request. In mebibytes (Mi)

maximum_pod_gpu_val.description: Maximum GPU allocation pod is allowed to have in resources.gpus.

postgres_engine_echo_for_debug.description: Whether or not to echo postgres engine queries for debugging.

cert_splash_enabled.description: When true, the health loop probes each http pod domain's TLS certificate and holds the Traefik splash route (rather than the real pod) until a valid Let's Encrypt cert is confirmed, logging provisioning progress to the pod's action_logs. Set false to disable cert tracking/holding entirely.

cert_probe_interval_seconds.description: Minimum seconds between TLS handshake probes for a single pod domain while its cert is being provisioned. Throttles outbound probes so a burst of starting pods can't stall the health loop.

cert_probe_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout (seconds) for the outbound TLS handshake used to detect whether a pod domain's Let's Encrypt cert is live.

cert_provisioning_max_seconds.description: How long to keep holding the splash / marking a domain 'provisioning' before giving up (state 'failed') and releasing the splash so the pod is at least reachable. Guards dev/local domains that will never get a public cert.

cert_splash_refresh_seconds.description: Auto-refresh / Retry-After interval (seconds) for the Traefik splash page shown while a pod is starting or its cert is being issued.

compute_queues.description: List of node objects available to the spawner using this config.

queue_name.description: Name of the queue being made available.

default.description: Whether or not this is the default queue to use.

node_selector.description: Kubernetes spec.nodeSelector required to access node. [A-z][0-9]-_ comma seperated. e.g. 'gpu,v100', 'region,us-west', 'name_id,my_node_id'

description.description: Description to be displayed in the UI.

cpu_info.description: CPU information of the node. e.g. 'Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU E5-2686 v4 @ 2.30GHz'

cpu_architecture.description: Architecture of the node. e.g. 'x86_64' or 'arm64'

default_memory_limit.description: Default memory (RAM) limit for this queue in mebibytes (Mi).

default_memory_request.description: Default memory (RAM) request for this queue in mebibytes (Mi).

min_memory.description: Minimum memory (RAM) allowed for this queue in mebibytes (Mi).

max_memory.description: Maximum memory (RAM) allowed for this queue in mebibytes (Mi).

default_cpu_limit.description: Default CPU limit for pods on this queue.

default_cpu_request.description: Default CPU request for pods on this queue.

min_cpus.description: Minimum CPU value allowed for this queue.

max_cpus.description: Maximum CPU value allowed for this queue.

ephemeral_storage_limit.description: Default ephemeral storage limit for this queue in mebibytes (Mi).

ephemeral_storage_request.description: Default ephemeral storage request for this queue in mebibytes (Mi).

min_ephemeral_storage.description: Minimum ephemeral storage allowed for this queue in mebibytes (Mi).

max_ephemeral_storage.description: Maximum ephemeral storage allowed for this queue in mebibytes (Mi).

tolerations.description: Kubernetes spec.tolerations required to tolerate the node.

gpu_resources.description: List of GPU resources available to the spawner using this config.

gpu_name.description: Colloquial name for the GPU device. e.g. 'NVIDIA Tesla V100-SXM2-16GB' or 'NVIDIA Tesla T4'

description.description: Description to be displayed in the UI for the device.

brand.description: Brand of the GPU device. e.g. 'NVIDIA' or 'AMD'

vram.description: Amount of VRAM on the device in GB.

activation_resource.description: Activation resource for the GPU device. What you put in K8 'spec.containers[X].resources.requests' to activate this GPU. e.g. 'nvidia.com/gpu' or 'nvidia.com/gpu.shared

default_gpu_request.description: Default int a user can request for this device.

max_gpu_request.description: Maximum gpus a user can request for this device. Time-sliced GPUs should say 1 unless they work different, if so, contact admin.

spawner_host_id.description: Unique host_id for worker host. Each host should have at least one spawner and health check worker.

test_abaco_service_password.description: Abaco service password is required to run tests as it's able to generate tokens.

local_development.description: Local/dev deployment flag. Must be true for local_admin_usernames to take effect — keeps that list inert (no admin backdoor) in production configs.

local_admin_usernames.description: Usernames granted admin access without requiring the pods_admin SK role. Only honored when local_development is true. Use only in local dev/test environments.

image_allow_list.description: Docker images that users are allowed to use.

nfs_base_path.description: Base path for nfs system root_dir. Should be /{base_path}/{tenant}/, tenant is added at runtime.

global_tenant_object.description: Object containing global parameters which tenants may overwrite at times.

log_ex.description: Default amount of time, in seconds, before a log is deleted from Mongo DB.

log_ex_limit.description: Ceiling for custom log_ex able to be set for a tenant.

web_max_log_length.description: Max length (bytes) to store an actors exec's logs. Truncated otherwise. Cannot exceed max mongo doc len.

use_tas_uid.description: Whether or not to use tas for authentication.

actor_uid.description: If using uid and gid, what uid globally should be set as.

actor_gid.description: If using uid and gid, what gid globally should be set as.

default_token.description: Default value for an actor's token attribute. Set globally.

generate_clients.description: Whether or not to generate clients when creating workers.

actor_homedir.description: Allows for specification regarding an actors homedir to use.

log_ex.description: Default amount of time, in seconds, before a log is deleted from Mongo DB.

log_ex_limit.description: Ceiling for custom log_ex able to be set for a tenant.

use_tas_uid.description: Whether or not to use tas for authentication for tenant.

actor_uid.description: If using uid and gid, what uid by tenant should be set as.

actor_gid.description: If using uid and gid, what gid by tenant should be set as.

default_token.description: Default value for an actor's token attribute. Set per tenant.

generate_clients.description: Whether or not to generate clients when creating workers for this tenant.

actor_homedir.description: Allows for specification regarding an actors homedir to use for this tenant.
